panes.name: T_Text_00
panes.text: 好きな島を　選んでね！

findings: The supplemental CharaMakeMap BFLYT contains four distinct prt1 panes L_Btn_00..03, each size 562×438, and each points to part_layout LCharaMakeMapBtn.

The LCharaMakeMapBtn BFLYT contains L_MapChoice_00 -> LMapChoice, L_LoadingIcon_00 -> LIconLoad, and a 418×418 P_Capture_00 picture. P_Capture_00 material binds only Black_00^r and Noise+r, both generic mask/noise inputs rather than an island preview image.

LMapChoice contains a 380×380 P_Map_00 picture in a scissor pane; its material binds Capture^t. The embedded BNTX entry decodes Capture^t as a uniform transparent 8×8 RGBA texture. This is a capture-named slot, not a static island preview image. The archive does not identify the runtime producer or prove that the slot is replaced at runtime.
Other LMapChoice texture is Noise^r. Its nested LMapIconOpenSpaceStart part uses FullMapIconMrk01^t and MiniMapIconOpenSpc^s for an open-space/map marker graphic, not an island screenshot.

LCharaMakeMapBtn textures and materials include frame corners/shadows (WorkBenchCardCornerR12^s, WorkBenchCardCornerR12Sh^s), card base corner (Corner^s), paper (TexPaper^s), wave pattern (MapWave^s), gradient/noise (GraSinV^w, Noise+r), and black mask (Black_00^r). These are card/UI decoration or shader inputs, not per-island image assets.

The available 1.0.0 converted Param/Layout/CharaMakeMap.json links only UI_CharaMakeMap and its dialog aliases (/L_Dialog_00, L_Dialog_00/L_BtnL, L_Dialog_00/L_BtnR). It contains no per-card part/image path and no cVillage literal. The raw BYML is absent from the workspace.

The supplemental UI archive directory carries a 2026-11-02 collection name but no explicit ACNH release/build id. Its exact relation to 1.0.0 is therefore OPEN. The actual dynamic source and lifetime of the Capture^t/P_Capture_00 content also remain OPEN.
